done.halo: HALO_ALPHA 0.11, spread 9 dp, no release after the word ends
done.player: the full-bleed PlayerHero player removed; the previous player restored with the lyrics mesh
done.background: PlaybackBuffer 30-180 s ahead with a 32 MB cap; BackgroundThrift (off screen and on battery: slow Ketmix analysis, no automatic separation); MemoryRelief releases the separation models on onTrimMemory; journal lines for data waits, data saver and memory warnings; Honor/Huawei App launch intents first with guidance in Settings. The real cause of the owner's cuts is not known: no playback journal from the phone was available
done.android_auto: MediaLibraryService with browse tree, search, voice and lazy resolution through Player; signed artwork provider; mobile flavour only; tested by MediaBrowser and MediaBrowserCompat connections under Robolectric
done.sliders_and_ui: SliderPress shared by seek bar, volume, glass and voice sliders (swell, reach, rubber band, reduced motion); row highlight, empty states, loading rows
done.ketmix_sign: Apple's logo and animation cannot be copied; KetmixMixingBadge uses Ketmix's own two-ring glyph (rings merge with the mix progress) and a sheen on its name, in the same place

known_limitations: Android Auto's queue screen shows only the current song; the real queue lives in the app.
Android Auto lists an app installed outside the Play Store only with Unknown sources on in its developer settings.
Songs are played about 0.09 s later whenever a separation model is installed (the voice stage runs from the start of every stream); the lyrics compensate.
Launcher icons keep a background: Android fills adaptive icon backgrounds in black.
Being a beta tag, the in-app updater does not offer it to users of a stable version; it is offered on the website and the releases page.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
